client_id.description: Specifies the OAuth2 client ID of the managed identity principal.

tenant_id.description: Specifies the ID of the Azure tenant that hosts the managed identity principal.

metric_names.description: List of metric names to be targeted (these apply to this resource type; use empty for all metrics).

locations.description: Locations to be ingested for this integration (these apply to all subscriptions; use empty for all locations).

resource_types.description: Metric groups to be ingested for this integration.

subscription_ids.description: Subscriptions to be targeted for this integration (use empty for all subscriptions).

count_metrics_enabled.description: Enables Azure count metrics for the configured resources.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the AzureMetricsIntegration was created. Cannot be set by clients.

name.description: The name of the AzureMetricsIntegration. You can modify this value after the AzureMetricsIntegration is created.

principal.description: The Azure principal that should be used for this config.

propagate_tags.description: Specifies whether Azure resource, group, and subscription tags should be propagated as metric labels.

scrape_config.description: Specifies the scrape config for this integration.

slug.description: The unique identifier of the AzureMetricsIntegration. If a `slug` isn't provided, one is generated based on the `name` field. You can't modify this field after the AzureMetricsIntegration is created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the AzureMetricsIntegration was last updated. Cannot be set by clients.

usage_metrics_enabled.description: Enables collection of azure usage metrics under this principal (Microsoft.Compute, Microsoft.Network, Microsoft.Storage).

next_token.description:
An opaque page token that identifies the next page of items that the
client should request. An empty value indicates that there are no
more items to return.
